events.note: 獣戦機基地 総攻撃 (Independence Army, scene 78): its end event unlocks 断空光牙剣 (3D6F 874). Final Dancouga @final is built for our roster (data/new_units.json combine: 219, 230, 233, 225, 228; the host builds the instance when the event starts, its crew the parts' pilots, its levels from 224) and @kougaken unlocked on it. From then on the map's 合体 of the beast fighters makes Final Dancouga when Black Wing stands next to them, not acted; without it, Dancouga as before. 分離 gives back all five.
見えない明日 (OZ route, scene 92): the same.

title.ja: ファイナルダンクーガ

text.ja: クリア時にアランとブラックウイングがいれば入手。以後、獣戦機を合体させるときブラックウイングが隣にいればファイナルダンクーガになる
text.zh-Hans: 通关时阿兰和黑翼在队即可获得。之后兽战机合体时，黑翼在旁边就合成终极断空我
text.zh-Hant: 過關時亞蘭和黑翼在隊即可獲得。之後獸戰機合體時，黑翼在旁邊就合成終極斷空我
text.en: Clear with Alan and Black Wing on your side to get it. After that, combining the beast fighters with Black Wing next to them forms Final Dancouga
text.ko: 클리어 시 알란과 블랙 윙이 있으면 입수. 이후 수전기를 합체할 때 블랙 윙이 옆에 있으면 파이널 단쿠가가 된다
